items.title: Overview of Relational Databases and SQL Structure

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Overview of Relational Databases and SQL Structure as printed (PDF 58, printed 54); its own lesson since 2026-10-29 (one lesson per book heading), moved from the topic 4.2 lesson.

blocks.text: Relational databases organize data into tables made of rows and columns. Each table stores related data in a structured manner. Relationships between tables are maintained using keys. SQL stands for Structured Query Language and is used to interact with databases. SQL commands help create, read, update, and delete data.
